messages:
Alex: Morning — quick async check. Noticed uptick in 99th latency for inference-prod around 02:05 UTC. Alerting fired for route /v1/generate (p99 > 800ms). I ran a quick sampling and saw a lot of small-batch fallbacks.

Alex: What I did: pulled logs from last 30m, checked autoscaler events, validated we have free GPU capacity.

Alex: Blockers: I can reproduce a pattern where the continuous-batcher falls back to single-request mode when KV-cache hits exceed ~1.2M entries; hitting an internal error: "batcher: kv-size exceeded, switching to passthrough". Need someone with batching internals to eyeball the kernel logs.

Maria: I saw the same. Ran this query on metrics-prod: `sum(rate(batch_fallback_total[5m])) by (pool)` — fallback spike aligns with a sudden drop in prefix-hit-rate.

Maria: Quick note: it correlated with a spike of very long prompts from a single customer (id: cust-214). Looks like their traffic pattern injected many unique prefixes, thrashing the cache.

Sam: Thanks. I have a small change in flight that adds a defensive cap to KV resizing (PR #4821). It prevents the fallback for a while but we still need to address root cause (unbounded prefix churn). Can someone review? @jen and @mike?

Jen: On it — I'll review PR #4821 this morning. Quick ask: can we add a short-term dashboard panel for `batch_fallback_total` by pool + top prefixes so oncall can triage faster? I'll open a grafana tile and share link when ready.

Mike: Re: oncall — I grabbed the pager at 02:10 and started a short muted paging loop. Left notes in the rotation doc: added cust-214 as noisy until we reach them. We should update runbook step 2 to include checking prefix-hit-rate. Current runbook only references queue depth.

Alex: Agree on runbook update. Jen, if you add that panel, also add a checkbox in the runbook for "check top prefix churn".

deploy-bot: Deploy started for infra/kv-size-cap v1.2.3 by sam — https://ci.internal/redwood/4821 — currently running canary on dedicated-pool-2.

Sam: Canary is green after 10m on pool-2. No increase in error count, fallback rate dropped ~70% in the canary windows. Rolling to 25% now.

Maria: I’ll follow up with the tenant ops/customer success to ask the customer for examples of prompt patterns so we can propose a mitigation (prompt dedupe, rate limits per-prefix).

Jen: PR reviewed, left one small comment re: metrics tags. I’ll merge after fix. Also created a Grafana panel: https://grafana.internal/d/xyz/batcher-health (added to the SRE home dashboard).

Mike: I updated oncall-runbook.md (section 2.3) with prefix-check steps and sample queries. Pushed to infra-docs repo.

Alex: Today: help Sam finish rollout, validate dashboards, and coordinate tenant outreach. If rollout looks stable, we can close the alert and draft a short postmortem blameless note (just causal timeline + mitigation).

Sam: FYI I'll leave a note in the deploy channel when we hit 100% and will tag oncall for a final check.

Maria: No blockers from my side once Sam finishes rollout. I'll prepare a short summary for CS.

Jen: Merging now. Will add the grafana link to the runbook checkboxes. :thumbsup:

Alex: Great — thanks all. If anything else pops, ping @eng-sre and I'll jump in.
